EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. DODS/LND/05/ACQ/37.
Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4/3/8/2011/PC/367.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the Land to be acquired: The land situated in the Village of Hiramadagama in minor division of Madapaththuwa in Atakalankorale in the Divisional Secretariat of Godakawela of the District of Rathnapura in the province of Sabaragamuwa and depictred as lots 102 to 121 in F.V.P. No. 604 in sheet No. 05 in supplementary No. 05.
01. Lot No. 102 Name of land: Angalangankumbura; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: T. Sirisena and Others, Panawala Road, Atakalanpanna; Extent: 0.0438 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Godakawela on the 30 th day of December 2015, at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 23rd Day of December, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
B. S. G. RUWANSIRI, Divisional Secretary, Godakawela

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. KDS/PAN/04/04/02/09.

I hereby give notice, that the notice published as preliminary Plan No. 5626 and Dated on 16th March 2009 in the Extra Ordinary Gazette notification No. 1593/1 of the Democratic Social Republic of Sri Lanka under section 7 of the land Acquisition notice is amended as 5926. *It is also informed that reassessment of ownership will be held on 23rd of December, 2015.
